- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:347-364 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When blocked issues coexist with genuinely in-progress issues, `check_issues()` returns `done=True, state=blocked` and silently drops the in-progress issues from the wait.
  WHY: The checker stops re-arming after the blocked verdict, so still-open follow-ups may complete without being handled.
- tests/test_check_in_status.py:509-521 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts `done=True` when a blocked issue and an unblocked still-open issue coexist, validating the behavior that drops the unblocked issue from the wait.
  WHY: This codifies an incorrect invariant: once the checker stops, nobody handles the still-in-progress follow-up if it later finishes.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:352 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If an issue has a missing or non-array `labels` value, `_label_names()` returns an empty list, so an issue carrying `ai:merged` may be treated as unresolved.
  WHY: A malformed labels shape could keep the checker waiting until the 7-day safety net fires; the reviewer notes this is pre-existing behavior, not a regression.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
